template: multiply(subtract(quantile(reverse(signed_power(ts_zscore(winsorize(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill({overall_genderratio}, 63), std=4), 20), std=4), 252), 2)), driver="gaussian"), ts_mean(quantile(reverse(signed_power(ts_zscore(winsorize(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill({overall_genderratio}, 63), std=4), 20), std=4), 252), 2)), driver="gaussian"), 60)), if_else(or(less(rank(winsorize(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill({overall_genderratio}, 63), std=4), 20), std=4)), 0.1), greater(rank(winsorize(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill({overall_genderratio}, 63), std=4), 20), std=4)), 0.9)), 1, 0))
idea: 高斯分位数拉伸纯尾部策略。将原始信号经reverse和signed_power处理后，通过quantile(..., driver="gaussian")将分布拉伸至高斯形态，突出极端尾部。计算其与60日移动平均的偏离作为动量差，并仅保留截面排名（rank）前10%与后10%的股票（使用if_else构造开关），完全剔除中间段噪音，构建极致的反转因子。
